scientific.integrity: The theorem is proved directly from the source boundary equations by an if-and-only-if reduction. The finite verifier only replays the parity algebra and is not used to infer the infinite statement.
scientific.limitations: Only eigenfunctions supported on exactly one loop are classified. Multi-loop compact states and the full spectral decomposition are not determined. The displayed energy formula uses the unit-interval normalization of the source equations.

title: Parity-selected compact loop eigenvalues in a quasi-delta quantum circuit
